title: Concourse Paths: Workspace Transit Concierge prototype
creator: Maya Choudhury
description: Design and prototype a lightweight "transit" pattern for workspace switching and primary console navigation that reduces cognitive load for power users while exposing role-aware shortcuts and an at-a-glance cost/rollout lens. The pattern (Concourse Paths) treats workspace switching as a micro-journey, combining quick-rail shortcuts, a compact map view for multi-workspace sessions, and a transient concierge panel for task-focused routing.
background: Current console navigation has grown organically: deep left rail, multiple contextual menus, and several overlapping quick-switch affordances. PM and Eng signal a need to reduce accidental route changes during live rollouts and to surface per-workspace cost telemetry during route selection. Research with three large customers highlighted confusion when switching contexts during high-traffic tests.
goals: Create a compact, discoverable workspace transit flow that reduces accidental context switches by 40% in prototype tests
Provide a role-aware concierge panel (admin, dev, observer) that highlights recently-used dashboards, rollout controls, and cost lenses
Keep primary left rail density low: surface only stable top-level routes and defer ephemeral actions to the transit panel
Enable keyboard and command-palette parity for all transit actions
Allow Eng to roll out via feature-flagged canary with clear telemetry hooks
constraints: Must be implementable without a major backend routing rewrite (uses route aliases and client-side routing table)
Sensitive actions (promote rollout, evict capacity) require explicit confirmation and cannot be executed from a transient panel
Design must fit within existing Console header height and left-rail breakpoint rules
acceptance_criteria: Clickable prototype demonstrates transit flow: quick-rail click -> transient concierge panel -> confirm/context switch
Prototype includes role-aware state (admin/dev/observer) and shows different primary actions per role
Usability test with 8 participants yields 30% faster common switch task and fewer accidental switches compared to control
Design tokens and spacing constraints documented for Eng handoff
design_notes: Transit panel is anchored mid-rail and floats over content to avoid reflow; it should be dismissible via Esc and click-away
Concierge shows three prioritized items: last active dashboard, active rollout controls, and cost snapshot for selected workspace
Cost snapshot is a condensed sparkline + 3-number summary (24h cost, 7d trend, unit cost estimate)
Keyboard shortcut cmd/ctrl+K opens global command palette; cmd/ctrl+\ opens transit concierge scoped to workspace switching
Persisted recent-workspaces list for quick-rail items (backend maintains MRU list; client falls back to cached list)
Accessibility: ensure transit panel focus trap, ARIA labels for role modes, and motion-reduced variant for animations
